canonical.definition: SYNTAPORE is the ELIMFILTERS diesel-fuel filtration architecture for primary, secondary and cartridge fuel-filter applications.
canonical.systems: Fuel Cleanliness Protection; approved diesel-fuel filtration applications.
canonical.failure_impact: Uncontrolled particulate contamination in diesel fuel can increase contamination exposure at pumps, injectors and other precision fuel-system components.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable fuel-filter test methods and application requirements must be selected for the approved system. The technology name alone does not imply a universal micron rating, efficiency, capacity or certification claim.
canonical.related_technologies: HYDROCORE: Standard non-turbine fuel/water separator architecture, including drain and transparent-bowl configurations. TURBOCORE: Turbine-style fuel/water separation exclusively for FH and FG series systems. SYNTAPORE governs plain staged diesel-fuel particulate filtration only.
canonical.industrial_role: SYNTAPORE provides the staged particulate-contamination control layer of ELIMFILTERS Fuel Cleanliness Protection. Selection is governed by the required filtration stage, efficiency, capacity, flow, pressure drop and protected fuel-system components.
